title: Christian Watson spat up blood, broke a rib, went to the hospital and returned to the game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Christian Watson spat up blood, broke a rib, went to the hospital and returned to the game
sources.description: Watson left Lambeau Field in an ambulance, spent an hour getting checked at the hospital, and then rode in an ambulance back to the stadium and played again.
